body:
## Source-status correction, not a new discovery

The literal AIM 2003 conformal-primitive implication has a known negative answer in dimension six. Branson's **2005** paper, printed p.40, equations (53)–(54), explicitly exhibits a conformal-index density whose conformal linearization is not formally self-adjoint. A local conformal primitive would force that symmetry.

This package credits the published obstruction and supplies a directly checkable closed-torus realization using Δ|P|² dV, with nonzero skew-linearization value 24. It neither proves nor disproves the later repaired formally self-adjoint conjecture in general dimensions and does not refute Alexakis's divergence decomposition.

## Duplicate and independent review

- 20002011 / AIM-GEOMETRY-0349 (Conjecture 1, p.17) and 20002052 / AIM-GEOMETRY-0390 (Problem 30, p.28) are exact duplicates
- One shared target and this one draft PR, with no separate proof budget for the duplicate
- Separate source and mathematical AI review: **PASS**, no required mathematical correction
- Frozen reviewed SHA-256: `b6d39596acb84613b15c43c5a9f6d2382bbd4826348638398d793fab4cbc7463`
- 25 author assertions and 21 independent exact geometric-jet checks passed
- Model and effort recorded accurately: gpt-6-astra, xhigh; no external peer-review claim

All changes are isolated to `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20002011/`. Start with its `README.md`, `SOURCE_STATUS.md`, and `independent_review/REVIEW.md`. Reproduce from that directory with `python3 check_jets.py` and `python3 independent_review/independent_checks.py` (SymPy 1.14.0).

No shared queue/state/catalog edits, routine release, merge, or outreach is included.
title: 20002011: reviewed source correction for known conformal-primitive obstruction
